name: Linked Provider Sign-In Succeeds
summary: The user selects Microsoft as the representative supported-provider permutation; the validated provider subject is already linked to exactly one active durable identity, so the server resolves that link and establishes the normal application session.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the Microsoft provider subject is already linked to exactly one active durable identity

serverInteraction.intent: Complete the external-provider ceremony, resolve the durable identity by provider subject rather than email, establish the normal session, and resolve the application landing destination.

postconditions.expression: the same durable identity is authenticated through its established provider-subject link and the application landing destination is active

sourceReferences.note: Existing linked-subject OAuth finalization is retained as implementation evidence; the current unlinked email auto-link/create branch is implementation drift and is not canonical.

External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.
